args.text:
Batch audit results
- Runs: 15 in the batch, 5 accepted (r02, r06, r07, r10, r11), 10 declined, none not reported.
- Flagged: none.
- Cleared (all 5 accepted runs): every check that was run passed. All of them have a centre REGR peak of about 42.0–42.5 %/h at 316 µm from the tip and a growth zone of 526–547 µm, the same as the batch median. Every summary has |z| ≤ 1.51. Each run kept one remedy and had no roll backs.
  - r06 and r07 registered their frames on non-growing tissue and passed all three checks. r07's rigid-body invariance (1.873 against a 2.0 limit) is close to the limit but passes.
  - r02, r10 and r11 reported the width-free ratio (−0.29 to −0.359, batch median −0.321), so plane sections was not run. Their plane-sections values (9.0–11.3 against 3.25) point to a change in root width, which the width-free ratio is meant to handle.
- What flagged runs have in common: no runs were flagged. Nine of the ten declined runs failed rigid-body invariance, and most of those have an unusual profile: a steep, short growth zone or large flank differences. The tenth, r08, failed only closure.
